newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Weizman to Egypt to meet Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Weizman to Egypt to meet Mubarak.

text.p: Israeli President Ezer Weizman will meet President Hosni Mubarak in Egypt next week, a spokeswoman for Weizman said on Monday.
She said Mubarak, whose country in 1979 became the first Arab state to sign a peace treaty with Israel, had invited Weizman. She said a specific date had yet to be decided.
Weizman, who as defence minister was an architect of the Israeli-Egyptian peace deal, was due to host Palestinian President Yasser Arafat for the first time on Tuesday.

Although Weizman's role as president is largely ceremonial, he played the conciliator in Israeli-PLO peace moves last month helping to persuade right-wing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to meet Arafat.
Mubarak, locked in a war of words with Netanyahu's government, has suggested Cairo might cancel a Middle East economic summit in November over what he regards as Israel's stalling peace moves.
